purpose: Teach: ロク/オンリー/゛/トロツキー/健太郎/二郎/ロビン/みずほ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、月次会議をロク、つまり六時から始めろ
lines.en: Our company's monthly meeting starts at six o'clock.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Each word lands with precision. No warmth—this is directive, not discussion. Steady eye contact at the subordinate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社のオンリーワン技術を社内で再共有します
lines.en: Yes. I'll share our proprietary technology across the team.
lines.style: Formal acknowledgment. Measured pace, slight emphasis on the commitment. Professional deference—listening carefully, confirming understanding. No shortcuts.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新人に濁点、つまり゛の使い方も基本から教えろ
lines.en: And make sure new hires learn the fundamentals—even the basic grammar marks—from the ground up.
lines.style: Firm instruction, slight pedagogical edge. Deliberate pause before 'even the basics' to underscore the point. Not harsh—exacting. The voice of someone who notices what's been overlooked.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員研修にトロツキー時代のロシア経済史を入れます
lines.en: Understood. I'll build that into the new staff orientation.
lines.style: Quiet confirmation. Accepting the scope without defensiveness. Businesslike tempo. A small nod in the tone—he's already thinking through how to execute.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新人の健太郎くんの指導役を決めろ
lines.en: And assign someone to mentor Kentaro, the new hire.
lines.style: Direct request, economical phrasing. Brief pause after 'mentor'—waiting for the answer to land. Not harsh, but expects immediate action. The voice of someone accustomed to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ラーメン二郎系列の取材記事を社内で参考にします
lines.en: Yes. I'll arrange a mentor for him right away.
lines.style: Quick, compliant response. No elaboration—he understands what's needed. Professional clip to the delivery. Brief and efficient.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海外パートナーのロビン氏との会合を設定しろ
lines.en: Set up a meeting with Robin from our overseas partner company.
lines.style: Clear instruction with slight formality around the name. Businesslike and decisive. No room for ambiguity. The tone of someone delegating and trusting it will be done.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。みずほ銀行との取引条件を見直します
lines.style: Final confirmation. Slight finality in the delivery—closing the series of directives. Professional, assured, ready to execute. A closing period rather than an opening.
